verdict.rationale: Okta documents event hooks: outbound HTTPS calls fired automatically when specified events occur in an org. That is a first-party event-triggered mechanism, but the only action evidenced is a call to a user-supplied URL, so the user must build the handler logic themselves. missing for 10: a documented rule/condition engine for defining automation logic, native built-in actions beyond outbound HTTP calls, details on event filtering and configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Event hooks are outbound calls from Okta, sent when specified events occur in your org. They take the form of HTTPS REST calls to a URL you specify
